newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan leader quashes coup rumors.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan leader quashes coup rumors.

text.p: Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera on Tuesday denied reports of an attempted coup to topple his government.
"Who would believe that," he told reporters when asked about a newspaper report that "state security institutions" had uncovered an army coup attempt over the weekend.
The report in the Caracas daily newspaper El Globo on Monday said the coup attempt was centred in the city of Maracay and was to be carried out sometime between last Thursday and Monday.
Defence Minister Pedro Nicolas Valencia also denied the report on Monday, saying it was "false, slanted and does not correspond to reality."
Rumours of military coups usually abound in Venezuela in February, ever since a Feb. 4, 1992 attempted coup by Gen. Hugo Cesar Chavez rocked the democratic institutions.
